item.title: The Bytes Moved, the Compute Didn't: A Field Report on Web3 Databases, via Web3DB
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: the field’s unsolved problem is not that consensus is too weak, it is that compute never followed the bytes. Web3DB is one of the few papers that prices this out loud: 22 TPC-H queries, 18 nodes, 2.85x speedup, 15.8% parallel efficiency, plus an explicit admission that it chooses CA and will not survive a partition.
